tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant pyuria, hematuria, nitrites, and bacteriuria. The presence of >100,000 CFU/mL Staphylococcus aureus confirms infection. Glucosuria is noted without ketonuria, which may warrant further evaluation for possible hyperglycemia. Low urine specific gravity suggests dilute urine. Clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy are recommended.
